transcript.answer: Yes. Issue #498 in re-cinq/Otto, "Stop the tool-budget message promising a follow-up while no escalation destination exists", is open. It is labelled type:bug and priority:medium, and it was opened on 2026-10-23. `TOOL_BUDGET_MESSAGE_DA` (from #151, shipped in #439) ends with "En kollega vil følge op på din henvendelse" ("a colleague will follow up"). With no escalation destination configured, nobody is notified, so the promise is empty. The issue is marked lore:blocked. It waits on a decision about what the message may promise (KU-14) and on a Danish speaker for any new wording (KU-15). PR #495 also flags the same problem.

judgements.reason: The answer identifies open issue #498 labelled lore:blocked, explains that the 'En kollega vil følge op' message notifies nobody without an escalation destination, and notes it is blocked on KU-14 and a Danish speaker (KU-15).
